parsed.name: AMI双轴超导磁体系统（带持久电流开关）
parsed.name_en: AMI Two-Axis Superconducting Magnet System with Persistent Current Switches
parsed.description: 这是一套双轴超导磁体系统，包含强轴Z和弱轴Y，并配有持久电流开关。系统可在两个正交方向上建立和保持磁场，并通过调节磁场大小、分量和角度，为低温物理、纳米器件和量子器件实验提供稳定可控的磁环境。
parsed.description_en: This is a two-axis superconducting magnet system with a strong Z axis, a weaker Y axis, and persistent current switches. It is used to generate and maintain magnetic fields along two orthogonal directions, allowing control of total field, field components, and field angle for low-temperature physics, nanodevice, and quantum-device experiments.
